title: EKA-EVAL : An Evaluation Framework for Low-Resource Multilingual Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces a framework (EKA-EVAL) designed for evaluating Large Language Models, specifically focusing on low-resource multilingual capabilities across tasks like reasoning, math, and code. While the authors mention cultural bias in existing benchmarks as a motivating factor for their work and provide a standard Ethics Statement, the framework itself does not include a component or suite specifically dedicated to evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
